description:
In the OpenClinica application (open in Firefox, already logged in as admin), create a new Case Report Form (CRF) by uploading the provided Excel template.

The CRF Excel file is located at '/home/ga/sample_crf.xls' inside the VM.

**Expected CRF Name:** 'Vital Signs' (defined in the Excel template)

The CRF template contains fields for vital signs measurements (blood pressure, heart rate, temperature, respiratory rate, weight, height). To create a CRF, navigate to the Tasks menu > Build Study > Create CRFs. Click on the 'Create a New CRF' link, then upload the Excel file, preview the CRF version, and confirm to save it to the database.

The CRF must appear in the CRF list with at least one version.
